Rashi on Ketubot 11b:10:1.hebrew: אלא אמר רבא לר"מ בין הכיר בה בין לא הכיר בה מאתים - ומתני' דקתני היא אומרת מוכת עץ אני, וקא תבעה מאתים — רבי מאיר היא:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:10:1.english: Rather, Rava said: According to Rabbi Meir, whether he was aware of her [condition] or was not aware of her [condition], [she receives] two hundred - And the mishna, which teaches "she says: I was injured by wood," and she claims two hundred [dinars] — it is [in accordance with] Rabbi Meir.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:10:2.hebrew: לרבנן הכיר בה מנה - ומתני' דהכא, דקתני וחכמים אומרים מוכת עץ מנה, היינו כשהכיר בה:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:10:2.english: According to the Rabbis, if he was aware of her, one maneh - And the mishna here, which teaches "and the Sages say: one injured by wood [receives] a maneh," [refers to a case] where he was aware of her [condition].

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:10:3.hebrew: לא הכיר בה ולא כלום - והא לא מצינו למימר לר' מאיר הכיר בה מאתים, לא הכיר בה מנה. דאי במקח טעות מחזקינן ליה, משום דלא הכיר בה לית לה מידי; ואי לאו מקח טעות הוא, אין חילוק בין הכיר ללא הכיר:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:10:3.english: [If] he was not aware of her, [she receives] nothing at all - For we cannot say according to Rabbi Meir [that if] he was aware of her, [she receives] two hundred, [and if] he was not aware of her, [she receives] a maneh. For if we regard it as a mistaken transaction, then because he was not aware of her [condition], she would have nothing; and if it is not a mistaken transaction, there is no distinction between [the case where] he was aware and [where] he was not aware:

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:11:1.hebrew: והדר ביה רבא גר' ול"ג מההיא - והדר ביה רבא ממאי דאמר: לרבנן לא הכיר בה — ולא כלום, אלא בין הכיר בין לא הכיר יש לה מנה לרבנן ומאתים לר"מ, ומתני' דהתם — דברי הכל:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:11:1.english: And Rava retracted — [this is] the reading, and we do not read "from that" - And Rava retracted from what he had said [earlier], that according to the Rabbis, [if] he was not aware of her [condition], [she receives] nothing at all; rather, whether he was aware or whether he was not aware, she receives one hundred [dinars] according to the Rabbis and two hundred according to Rabbi Meir, and the mishna there is [in accordance with] everyone.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:11:2.hebrew: הוצאת שם רע - ליענש מאה כסף אם שקר, וליסקל אם אמת היה:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:11:2.english: Slander - [For the husband] to be fined one hundred silver [shekels] if [it is] false, and for [her] to be stoned if it was true.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:11:3.hebrew: בא לב"ד - זקוק לבוא לב"ד ואומר כו':
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:11:3.english: He comes to court - He is required to come to court and say, etc.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:12:1.english: And Rav Ḥiyya said - We read [this in the text].

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:12:2.english: And Rav Naḥman raised an objection - We read [this in the text].

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:12:3.hebrew: נסתחפה שדהו - מזלך גרם, כאדם שהמטר בא וסוחף את זריעתו ועוקרה:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:12:3.english: His field was inundated - Your [ill] fortune caused [it], like a person for whom the rain comes and sweeps away his planting and uproots it.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:13:1.english: When Rav Sheshet stated this teaching - [Referring] to this "That is to say" [statement] above, that she has a ketubah [of] a maneh.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:13:2.english: And [it] was difficult for them - [This refers to] that which we raised as an objection.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:14:1.english: And Rava said - We read [the text thus].

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:14:2.english: A mistaken transaction implies [that it is] completely [void] - and she has nothing.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:14:3.hebrew: ואלא קשיא הך - ואקשינן לרבא: אלא קשיא הך דלעיל, דקתני זינתה מעיקרא יש לה כתובה מנה:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:14:3.english: But that [baraita] is difficult - And we ask Rava: But that [baraita] above is difficult, as it teaches [that if] she engaged in intercourse initially [prior to betrothal], she has a marriage contract of a maneh.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:14:4.hebrew: תריץ - לההיא דלעיל דכיצד הוצאת ש"ר, תירוצא דתרצת לה לא תתרצה הכי, אלא הכי: אם יש עדים כו':
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:14:4.english: Resolve - [With regard] to that [baraita] above concerning "How is defamation [brought]?": the resolution that you resolved for it, do not resolve it thus, rather [resolve it] thus: "If there are witnesses, etc."

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:14:5.hebrew: נמצאת - לא הכיר בה משמע, וקא מתרץ רבא יש לה כתובה מנה. אלמא הדר ביה מההיא דלעיל, דהא איהו אמר לרבנן ולא כלום, וכרבי מאיר נמי לא תוקמה, דהא רבי מאיר מאתים קאמר:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:14:5.english: She was discovered - [This] implies [that] he had not recognized [her condition], and Rava resolves [the baraita to state that] she has a marriage contract of one hundred [dinars]. Thus, he retracted from that [statement] above, for he had said [that] according to the Rabbis [she receives] nothing at all; and you cannot establish it according to Rabbi Meir either, for Rabbi Meir says [she receives] two hundred [dinars].

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:16:1.hebrew: ויש לה עדים שלא נסתרה - רבותא אשמעינן, דאפי' הכי אין השני יכול לטעון טענת בתולים להפסידה כתובתה ולימא מקח טעות הוא:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:16:1.english: And she has witnesses that she did not seclude herself - [The baraita] teaches us a novel point, that even so, the second [husband] cannot make a virginity claim to cause her to lose her ketubah and say it is a mistaken transaction.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:16:2.english: Since the first [husband] brought her in - And it is upon him [the second husband] to know that she had intercourse.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:1:1.hebrew: ואין להן טענת בתולין - אין יכול להפסידה אותה מנה, ולומר: בחזקת בתולה נשאתיך, והרי מקחי מקח טעות:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:1:1.english: And they have no claim of virginity - He cannot cause her to forfeit that maneh [of her ketubah], and say: "I married you on the presumption that you were a virgin, and behold, my purchase is a mistaken purchase."

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:3:1.hebrew: עשאה מוכת עץ - נהי דאין ביאתו ביאה, מיהו לא גרע מעץ הנתקע. ולרבנן דפליגי אמוכת עץ, כתובתה מנה. וכן לענין כהן גדול, דתנן (יבמות דף נט) לא ישא את מוכת עץ, הא נמי אסירא ליה:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:3:1.english: He rendered her [like] one struck by wood - Granted that his intercourse is not [considered] intercourse, nevertheless it is no worse than a piece of wood that is inserted. And according to the Rabbis who dispute [the law of] one struck by wood, her marriage settlement is one hundred [zuz]. And likewise with regard to the High Priest, as we learned (Yevamot, page 59): "He shall not marry one struck by wood" — this woman, too, is forbidden to him.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:3:2.hebrew: אין מוכת עץ בבשר אדם - ואי אמרת בעולה לא הויא, מוכת עץ נמי ליתא:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:3:2.english: There is no [status of] one struck by wood through human flesh - And if [you say that] she is not [considered] one who has been had [i.e., a non-virgin], she also does not have the status of one struck by wood.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:4:1.hebrew: באפי נפשה - בלא גברי, דלא אמר רב יהודה משמיה דרב ומשמיה דשמואל, אלא אינהו גופייהו איפלוג בה:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:4:1.english: Independently - Without [mention of] men [i.e., without attribution to earlier authorities], for Rav Yehuda did not say [it] in the name of Rav and in the name of Shmuel; rather, they themselves disagreed about it.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:5:1.hebrew: וקטן שבא על הגדולה ומוכת עץ - ומדפלגינהו תנא לתרתי, ולא איפלוג רבנן אלא במוכת עץ, שמעת מינה: אין מוכת עץ בבשר:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:5:1.english: And a minor [boy] who engaged in intercourse with an adult woman, and one ruptured by wood - Since the Tanna separated them into two [cases], and the Rabbis disagreed only regarding one ruptured by wood, you may conclude from this that [the case of] one ruptured by wood is not [the same as that of intercourse] with flesh.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:6:1.hebrew: הכי קאמר גדול הבא על הקטנה ולא כלום - אינה ביאה לדברי הכל. הלכך כתובתה מאתים, ולא איפלוג רבנן עלה. והטעם דפחות מכאן כנותן אצבע בעין, דתנן במסכת נדה (דף מד:) גבי בת פחותה מג' שנים ויום אחד: מה הדמעה היוצאת ע"י אצבע, באה אחרת תחתיה — אף בתולים של פחות מכן חוזרין, אחרים תחתיהם:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:6:1.english: This is what it is saying: An adult who engaged in intercourse with a minor girl — [it is] nothing - It is not [considered] intercourse, according to everyone. Therefore her marriage contract is two hundred [dinars], and the Rabbis do not dispute this. [The reason is] that [a girl] younger than this is like one who puts a finger into an eye, as we learned in tractate Niddah (44b) regarding a girl younger than three years and one day: Just as a tear that emerges through [poking with] a finger — another comes in its place, so too the hymen of one younger than this — others return in their place:

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:6:2.hebrew: וקטן שבא על הגדולה - מוכת עץ היא זו, וכתובתה מאתים, דברי רבי מאיר. וחכמים אומרים: כל מוכת עץ כתובתה מנה, והא נמי דקא משוית לה מוכת עץ — כתובתה מנה:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:6:2.english: And a young boy who engaged in intercourse with an adult woman - She is [considered] one injured by wood, and her marriage contract is two hundred [dinars], according to Rabbi Meir. But the Sages say: Any woman injured by wood has a marriage contract of one hundred [dinars]; and this one too, whom you render [as] one injured by wood — her marriage contract is one hundred [dinars].

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:7:1.hebrew: כשהכיר בה - כשכנסה וכתב לה כתובה, היה יודע שהיא מוכת עץ:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:7:1.english: Where he was aware of her - When he married her and wrote her a marriage contract, he knew that she was one whose [hymen was ruptured] by wood.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:7:2.hebrew: מדמי לה לבוגרת - דקיימא לן שכלו בתוליה במס' יבמות (דף נט.), דקתני "בבתוליה" — פרט לבוגרת שכלו בתוליה. ואפי' הכי, כתובתה מאתים:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:7:2.english: He likens her to a grown woman - For we hold that her hymen has been destroyed, in tractate Yevamot (59a), where it teaches "in her virginity" — excluding a grown woman whose hymen has been destroyed. And even so, her marriage contract is two hundred [dinars].

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:7:3.hebrew: ולא כלום - דמקח טעות הוא, ואפי' מנה אין לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:7:3.english: And nothing at all - For it is a mistaken transaction, and she does not have even a maneh.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:9:1.hebrew: היא אומרת מוכת עץ אני - משנתנו היא:
Rashi on Ketubot 11b:9:1.english: She says: I am one ruptured by wood - It is our Mishnah.

Rashi on Ketubot 11b:9:2.hebrew: והוא אומר לא כי אלא דרוסת איש את - הנושא את האשה בחזקת בתולה, ולא מצא לה בתולים, והיא אומרת: מוכת עץ אני כו'. ש"מ אית לה כתובה, או מנה או מאתים, דאי לית לה, מאי נאמנת דקאמר רבן גמליאל? אלמא, מוכת עץ שלא הכיר בה יש לה כתובה. תיובתא דרמי בר חמא, דאמר לא הכיר בה דברי הכל ולא כלום:

Tosafot on Ketubot 11b:10:1.hebrew: לרבנן הכיר בה מנה לא הכיר בה ולא כלום - ומתני' ר"מ היא ולא רבנן. ואם תאמר: אמאי לא קאמר לרבנן בין הכיר בה בין לא הכיר בה — מנה, כדקאמר במסקנא, ותיתי מתניתין לדברי הכל? וי"ל, דלא ניחא ליה למימר הכי, דכיון דרבנן מדמו לה לבעולה, הויא בלא הכיר בה כמו כנסה בחזקת בתולה ונמצאת בעולה, וסבירא ליה דלית לה ולא כלום. ובמסקנא סבר: הא דמדמו לה לבעולה — היינו לענין מנה, אבל מקח טעות לא הויא כמו בעולה, דאינו מקפיד כ"כ במוכת עץ שיהא מקח טעות:
Tosafot on Ketubot 11b:10:1.english: "According to the Rabbis, [if] he was aware of her [condition, she receives] one hundred dinars; [if] he was not aware of her [condition, she receives] nothing at all" - And the Mishnah is [in accordance with] Rabbi Meir, and not the Rabbis. And if you will ask: Why did [Rava] not say [that] according to the Rabbis, whether he was aware of her [condition] or whether he was not aware of her [condition, she receives] one hundred dinars, as [the Gemara] says in the conclusion, so that our Mishnah would accord with everyone? And one can answer that it was not amenable to him to say so; for since the Rabbis compare her to a non-virgin, [a case where] he was not aware of her [condition] is like [one who] married a woman on the presumption [that she was] a virgin and she was found to be a non-virgin, and he holds that she has nothing at all. And in the conclusion, [the Gemara] holds [that] that which they compare her to a non-virgin is [only] with respect to [receiving] one hundred dinars, but it is not a mistaken transaction like [a case of] a non-virgin, because one is not so particular about a woman whose hymen was ruptured by wood that it should be a mistaken transaction.

Tosafot on Ketubot 11b:15:1.hebrew: הדר ביה רבא מההיא - אבל מהא לא בעי למימר דהדר ביה, משום דמקח טעות לגמרי משמע. וא"ת: מנא לן דהדר ביה ממה שאמר לרבנן "לא הכיר בה ולא כלום"? נאמר שחזר בו ממה שאמר "לא הכיר בה" לר"מ מאתים, אלא נפרש "לא הכיר בה — מנה", ונוקי ברייתא כרבי מאיר! וי"ל כדפי' לעיל בקונטרס, דאין זה סברא: דאי חשיב מקח טעות — לא יהא לה כלום, ואי לא חשיב מקח טעות — למה לא יהא לה מאתים, כיון דמדמה לה לבוגרת? דאטו לבוגרת פוחתין לה מכתובתה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 11b:15:1.english: Rava retracted that [statement] - However, [the Gemara] did not want to say that he retracted this [statement], because "a mistaken transaction" implies [that the marriage is void] completely. And if you ask: How do we know that he retracted what he said according to the Rabbis, [namely,] "[if] he was not aware of her [condition], she receives nothing at all"? Let us say [instead] that he retracted what he said according to Rabbi Meir, [namely, that if] "he was not aware of her [condition], [she receives] two hundred [dinars]," and rather, we should explain [that according to Rabbi Meir, if] "he was not aware of her [condition], [she receives] one hundred [dinars]," and establish the baraita in accordance with Rabbi Meir! And one can answer, as Rashi explained above, that this is not logical: for if it is considered a mistaken transaction, she should receive nothing at all; and if it is not considered a mistaken transaction, why should she not receive two hundred [dinars], since [Rabbi Meir] compares her to a bogeret [an adult woman] — for is a bogeret's ketubah reduced?

Tosafot on Ketubot 11b:4:1.hebrew: ושמואל אמר אין מוכת עץ בבשר - בלא השיר בתולין איירי; דאי בהשיר, למה יש לה להיות פחותה ממוכת עץ:
Tosafot on Ketubot 11b:4:1.english: "And Shmuel said: There is no [status of] one ruptured by wood through flesh" - [Shmuel] is speaking of a case where [the minor] did not remove the hymen; for if he did remove it, why should she be [regarded as] inferior to one ruptured by wood?
